title: The Red Oil Can Is Not an Oil-Change Reminder
topic: Oil-pressure warning and oil-life reminder are different signals
mechanicTruth: An engine oil-pressure warning indicates a possible lubrication-pressure problem, while an oil-life or maintenance reminder estimates service timing; a normal oil level does not by itself prove normal oil pressure.

voiceoverScript: The red oil-can warning is not your oil-change reminder. It can indicate a lubrication-pressure problem. Low level is one possible cause, but a normal level does not prove normal pressure. Stop safely and diagnose the cause.
selectedCaption: Oil-life reminders and oil-pressure warnings are different signals. A persistent oil-pressure warning deserves diagnosis, not a routine change-it-later interpretation.
